tokenName: Zambia National Building Society SME Digital Token
underlyingAsset: Small & Medium Enterprise portfolio of Zambia National Building Society
description: Tokenised SME loan portfolio of Zambia National Building Society. Each token represents a fractional share of diversified SME credit facilities issued under Zambia SME development policy.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Banking Act; Central Bank SME Tokenisation Framework 2024

tokenName: Zambia National Building Society Warehouse Receipt Token
description: Warehouse receipt token issued by Zambia National Building Society against commodity stock deposited at certified warehouses in Zambia. Tradeable digital receipt on Algorand.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Warehouse Receipts Act; Central Bank Commodity Tokenisation Guidelines

tokenName: Zambia National Building Society Agriculture Finance Token
description: Digital token representing agricultural credit facilities provided by Zambia National Building Society to smallholder farmers and cooperatives in Zambia.
regulatoryFramework: Zambia Agriculture Finance Act; Central Bank Green Finance Policy 2024
